_doc: Conversation scripts for conversations/js/conversations.js. topic: { id, tags, weight, requires: [ { who: asker|answerer|third, memory: type (+maxAgeHours, details, detailsNot), gear: { slot, minKills, delta: better|worse, maxDaysAgo, replaced }, bag: { minDaysAgo }, stats: { kills|damage|fights|downs|healing: number | "top" }, party: { key: value | {min,max,is} }, trait, notTrait, relation: { to, min, max } } ], lines: [ { role, to?, optional?, variants: [ { t: template, cond? } ] } ] }. Templates use Lingo syntax; bindings: asker/answerer/third (speakers), memory.* (details + when + count), foe/place/item (entities from the memory), weapon + gear.{kills,damage,delta,deltaAbs,replaced,daysAgo}, bagItem + bag.*, stats.*, party.* (rations, exhaustion, vehicleName, act, nextBoss, companion…).

variants.t: {answerer.name}, what did you make of {memory.when} — {foe.count} {foe.pl} at {place.the}?
So. The {foe.pl}. Talk me through it, {answerer.name}.
{answerer.name}. That fight {memory.when}. Honest opinion.
{foe.count} {foe.pl} and not a scratch on me. Write that down.
I took a cut. It's nothing. {foe.count} of them, and it's nothing.
We won. That's the whole review. {foe.count} {foe.pl}, one pile.
Messy. We won because they were stupid, not because we were good. I want that said before anyone gets cocky.
I keep seeing the {foe.sg} that nearly got past me. Ask me again in a week.
My {weapon} did most of that, if we're being honest. {gear.kills} kills on it now.
I counted. Nobody thanks the one who counts.
Fair. Sleep on it. There'll be more.
Good. Same again tomorrow, then.
Cocky. I like it.
You went quiet after the {foe.pl}, {answerer.name}.
That last fight — you were bleeding. Don't say you weren't.
A {foe.sg} got under my guard. Once. It won't happen twice.
I was slow. Cold hands. {~It happens.|Don't make it a thing.|I'll be faster.}
I nearly died at {place.the} and you want to chat about it by the fire.
Bind it properly. I've seen a scratch turn a leg black in three days.
{~Eat something.|Drink.|Sleep.} Wounds close on full stomachs.
Next time shout. I'll be there.
Then I'll stand closer.
This {weapon} has {gear.kills} kills on it. {~I've named it.|I don't name things, but I'm tempted.|It earned its keep.}
{gear.kills} dead by this {weapon} since I picked it up. {gear.damage} damage dealt, if you like numbers.
You count? Who counts?
{gear.damage} in how many swings? That's what matters.
Careful. Blades that get counted get cocky.
Someone has to keep score.
Cocky is fine. Dead is not. {~So far, so good.|Ask the {gear.kills} who disagreed.}
My turn to hold it tomorrow.
Mine's still at zero. Say nothing.
{answerer.name}, the meter says you did most of the hurting today.
Top of the pile again, {answerer.name}. {stats.damage} damage. Leave some for the rest of us.
Naturally.
Somebody had to. {~You were busy falling over.|You were busy healing me, which I noticed. Thank you.}
Numbers. Fine. Next fight you take the front and we'll see whose numbers grow.
I healed for more than either of you hit for. Nobody makes a bar for that.
I'll take a small pile and a whole skin, thanks.
You went down today, {answerer.name}. How's the head?
We carried you out of {place.the}. You owe me a drink and an apology to my back.
I remember the {foe.sg}, then the sky, then your ugly face. Thank you. Don't mention it again.
Down isn't dead. {~Write that on my stone when it's time.|I've been down before.}
I'm not going down again. I'll take the back line and I'll take the shame.
Next time I'll put the barrier on you first. My mistake.
Eat double tonight. That's an order from someone with no rank.
Is that new, {answerer.name}? The {weapon}?
Show me the {weapon}. Better than what you had?
Found it {gear.daysAgo, plural, =0{today} one{yesterday} other{# days ago}}. Beats {gear.replaced} by about {gear.deltaAbs} — you can feel it in the swing.
Better by {gear.deltaAbs} on whatever scale you smiths use. {~The old one's in the bag if anyone wants it.|Sold the old one. No sentiment.}
It is magnificent and I will not be taking questions.
{gear.kills, plural, =0{No kills on it yet. Tomorrow.} one{One kill already.} other{# kills already. It works.}}
Don't get attached. They break.
Good. Then you're in front tomorrow.
Why are you carrying that {weapon}? The old one was better.
That {weapon}. You took a step backwards, {answerer.name}.
It looks better. {~Looks count for something.|Don't they?}
It's worse by {gear.deltaAbs}, I know. {~The old one was falling apart.|I'll swap back. Don't gloat.|I like the weight.}
I know exactly what I'm doing.
Your funeral. Literally, possibly.
Swap it before the next fight. I'm not carrying you.
{answerer.name}, that {bagItem} you found — still in the bag?
Whatever happened to the {bagItem}? {bag.daysAgo} days you've hauled it.
Gathering dust. {~Sell it in town.|Somebody take it.|It'll be worth something to someone.}
I forgot I had it. {~That's the honest answer.|Don't tell the merchant.}
I'm saving it for the right moment.
If nobody wants it, I'll salvage it for scrap. Iron is iron.
We found {item.a} {memory.when}. {memory.worth.cap}, I'd say.
{item.the.cap} from {place.the} — did anyone look at it properly?
Looked. {~Held it.|Sniffed it.|Weighed it.} {~Junk.|Decent.|Better than it looks.}
Who's carrying it? Because it isn't me.
Everything we pick up is somebody's grave-goods. Just saying.
Mind we don't die for loot. Loot doesn't mourn.
You're standing taller, {answerer.name}.
Something's different about you today.
Level {memory.level}. {~I can feel it in my shoulders.|Don't ask how it works. It works.|The old wounds close faster.}
Stronger. {~Not wiser.|Sadly not richer.}
Buy the good talent, not the flashy one.
Spend the points before the next fight or I'll spend them for you.
Long day. {place.the.cap} goes on forever.
How many more of these roads before something's actually different?
Every road ends somewhere with teeth.
{~Three|Two|Four} more days of this and we're through. Probably.
I like the roads. {~Nobody's trying to kill us on the roads.|Mostly.}
My feet have opinions. Loud ones.
{party.rations, plural, =0{We are out of food. Say it with me: out of food.} one{One ration left. One.} other{# rations. Count them before the {$creature.pl} do.}}
How's the food, {answerer.name}?
Count the rations. Out loud.
{party.rations, plural, =0{None. We're eating our belts tomorrow.} one{One. Split four ways, that's a mouthful.} other{#. Not enough.}}
{~Bad.|Thin.|Somebody's been sneaking.} We buy food in town or we start eating what we kill.
Goblin isn't as bad as people say.
I saved a crust. Don't look at me like that.
You've gone grey, {answerer.name}. When did you last eat?
Nobody's marching straight. We're worn thin.
Two days on water. {~My hands shake.|I missed a goblin at arm's length.|I'll be fine when there's bread.}
Exhausted. It's a word for hungry and stubborn at once.
Town. Tomorrow. No detours for shiny ruins.
The {party.vehicleName} was a good buy. Say it.
We'd be a day behind without the {party.vehicleName}.
It rattles. {~I've said my piece.|Every bone in me knows it rattles.}
Good buy. {~Better than my boots.|Now buy me boots.}
It draws eyes. Wagons draw thieves. We'll see who's right.
I'll sleep under it. Warmer than the sky.
Last night's {foe.pl} — anyone hear them coming?
Who was on watch when the {foe.pl} came? {~Nobody. Right.|I was. Sorry.}
I heard the fire pop and then a {foe.sg} was in my blanket. {~Never again.|Double watch.}
We should sleep with the boots on. All of us.
Or we buy a wagon with high sides and stop arguing about watches.
Be honest, {answerer.name}. Am I any good at this?
{answerer.name}. Would you follow me into {place.the}? Wherever that is.
You're better than you think and worse than you say.
I'd follow you. {~Don't make it a speech.|Ask again when I'm sober.}
You're good. {~Loud, but good.|Slow, but good.|Reckless, but good.}
I'm right here, you two.
Something on your mind, {answerer.name}? You've been staring.
Say it. Whatever it is.
You left me standing alone {~at the ford|in the last fight|with three on me}. I noticed.
Nothing. {~Nothing worth the fire.|Eat your food.}
I don't like you. It doesn't matter. We fight the same direction.
Fine. I'll do better. Or I won't, and you'll say so again.
Noted.
Does anyone actually trust Silas Veilward?
{silas_veilward.name} knew where the cult was too early. Nobody else thinks that's odd?
I trust nobody who talks in riddles.
He's kept us alive. That buys a lot of odd.
The Ashen Veil had him once. People don't come back from that clean.
If he turns, I want first swing.
Keep your voice down. Roads have ears out here.
What is the Veil, really? Nobody says it plainly.
The Corruption. Is it a thing, or is it someone?
Fire between worlds. Everything we call magic is what leaks through.
Someone. It has intent. You can feel it choosing.
Doesn't matter what it is. It bleeds. So it dies.
Mira said something was on the other side, pushing. I believed her.
{party.nextBoss} is ahead of us. Plans?
We're close to {party.nextBoss}. I want everyone's honest plan.
I go in first. The rest of you keep up.
Potions on the belt, not in the bag. Healer in the back. Nobody gets clever.
Sleep. Eat. Then hit it until it stops.
I'll save my best spell for the second half. Bosses always have a second half.
The {party.companion} keeps looking at me.
Who's feeding the {party.companion}? It's getting fat.
It likes you. {~Somebody should.|That's rare.}
I feed it. It fights better than most of us. {~No offence.|Some offence.}
It ate my glove.
{~Cold night.|Quiet night.|Too quiet.} {~Anyone else feel it?|Anyone awake?}
Look at that sky.
I feel it. Something out there is patient.
It's a night. They happen. Sleep.
{~Beautiful, if you forget what's under it.|I miss walls.|I miss beds.}
I'll take first watch. Nobody argue.
You never talk about before, {answerer.name}.
Who did you lose? You can say.
Someone. {~The road took them.|The Veil took them.|A fever took them, which is worse, because there's nobody to hit.}
Not tonight. {~Tomorrow, maybe.|Ask me after the next fight.}
When you're ready.
Then we'll hit something for them tomorrow.
Right, who wants a song? {~No? Tough.|Silence means yes.}
A toast! To {~not being dead|the {foe.pl} we haven't met|small mercies and big swords}!
Sing and I'll gag you with a ration.
One song. A quiet one.
{~Fine.|Go on then.|If you must.}
Sing the one about the goblin king. The rude one.
You've been scribbling all day, {answerer.name}. What's {place.the} to you?
Tell me something about {place.the} that isn't grim.
{place.the.cap} is older than the maps. The stones were cut before the Veil tore. Nothing about that is grim; it's a comfort.
Before the goblins it was a dwarven ore-test. Before the dwarves, something else. Everything's on top of something.
Fascinating. Pass the bread.
{stats.healing} points of healing today. I'm keeping a tally now. Nobody claps for the tally.
You are all alive because of me. Say it back.
We're alive because of you. {~And the sword.|Mostly you.}
Clap clap. Now heal my knee.
I'd have been fine.
{memory.when.cap} you said "{memory.said}". {~Did you?|Still true?|Well?}
Remember what you told me {memory.when}? "{memory.said}".
I remember. {~I meant it.|I was tired.|Ask me again tomorrow.}
I say a lot of things by a fire.
I did say that. {~Hold me to it.|I'll get to it.}
I remember it too. Everyone remembers everything out here.
You still sore about what you said the other night?
We never finished that argument.
I'm not sore. {~I'm right.|I'm tired.}
We finished it. You just didn't like the ending.
Then we're fine.
Then eat, and we'll see.
You said you'd swap that {weapon}. It's still in your hand.
Still carrying the worse one, I see.
I like it. {~We've been through this.|Leave it.}
Tomorrow. {~I said tomorrow last time, I know.}
Somebody take it off {answerer.them} while {answerer.they} sleeps.
You swapped it. Good.
Better {weapon} today. Somebody listened.
I listen. {~Occasionally.|Don't get used to it.}
It was the {gear.replaced} or my pride. Pride's lighter.
Miracles.
{memory.name}. Say it. We owe that one.
Nobody's talking about {memory.name}. So I will.
{memory.name} put me on my back at {place.the}. Next time I go first and I go for the throat.
I'd rather not meet {memory.name} again, honestly. I'd rather a lot of things.
We were tired and it was fast. {~Excuses.|That's all it was.} It'll be back.
Named things come back. That's what names are for.
I dreamt about it. It had my knife.
{memory.name} is dead. {~I want that written somewhere.|Say it twice; it sounds better twice.}
We finally got {memory.name}. {memory.when.cap}, at {place.the}.
About time.
I kept the ear. {~Don't look at me like that.|Proof.}
Who gets the story rights? Because I'm telling it differently.
There'll be another one with a worse name by next week.
That one with the name. {party.lastNamed}. What was that?
Regular goblins don't have names. {party.lastNamed} did.
Champions. Warlords. Whatever the Veil makes when it pays attention.
Bigger, meaner, and it knew our faces. That's what.
Bounty boards pay for names. I checked.
If it comes back, mine.
The {party.companion} got {party.companionKills, plural, one{a kill} other{# kills}} today. More than some of us.
Who's the best fighter here? Because the {party.companion} has opinions.
Don't compare me to a dog.
Good {party.companion}. {~Deserves the bigger share.|Gets my ration.}
It doesn't count. It doesn't have to carry anything.
It counts. I saw the goblin's face.
The {party.companion} is limping.
Somebody look at the {party.companion}'s leg.
I bound it. {~It bit me. Fair.|It'll walk tomorrow.}
Bandages are for people. {~I said that out loud. Sorry.|Fine, one bandage.}
If it dies I'm not fighting tomorrow.
So. {newcomer.name}. Thoughts?
New face at the fire. {newcomer.name}.
{memory.impression.cap}. {~That's my whole report.|Ask me in a week.}
Eats a lot. {~Fights, though.|We'll see.}
Give it time. We were all new once. {~Some of us still are.}
{party.activeQuest}. That's the job. Anyone remember why we took it?
We're still on {party.activeQuest}, in case anyone forgot.
Coin.
Because someone had to, and we were standing there.
The board said {party.questGold} gold. I remember that part.
I remember the part where it's dangerous.
{party.lastQuestDone}: done. {~Paid.|Mostly paid.|Paid in gold and in scars.}
Cross {party.lastQuestDone} off. Somebody write that down.
What's next on the board?
Good. Drink to it. Then sleep.
There's always a next one.
Kaela Thorne was ahead of us again. How does she do that?
If Kaela Thorne beats us to the Sovereign I'll never hear the end of it.
She travels light and sleeps less. We could learn something.
Rivals are useful. Somebody has to be ahead so we know where the road is.
She's welcome to the Sovereign. Let her die first.
I like her. Don't tell her.
That scholar. Marek Greel. He's always where the worst of it is.
Does anyone know where Marek Greel sleeps? I've never seen him sleep.
Scholars follow ruin. It's where the notes are.
He offered sympathy when Lysa died. Too fast. Sympathy takes a breath first.
Keep him where you can see him. That's all I'll say.
Or in front of us, when the demons come.
Mother Yssira said one of us wouldn't come back. Which one?
The seer's words keep me up. 'Three voices to close the door.'
Prophecy is a debt collector. It always comes.
Seers say things. Then things happen. Then everyone claps for the seer.
If it's me, sell my gear. Don't bury it.
If it's me, keep the {~axe|bow|staff}. It's better than yours.
Miss Emberglen yet?
Turnip fields and geese. I'd give a rare sword for the geese right now.
I miss walls. {~And the priest.|And bread that isn't a rock.}
Emberglen was three roads and a well. But it was ours.
It'll be there when we're done. Probably.
My feet. {~Say something about my feet.|I want it noted.}
Three nodes a day on foot. A wagon does four.
Buy a mule. {~Mules don't complain.|Mules carry the food.}
We'd have a wagon if someone hadn't bought the {~rapier|ring|fancy boots}.
I'll carry the mule.
No torches. So we sit in the dark and hope.
Last torch burnt out. Who was supposed to buy more?
Dark is fine. {~The fire's enough.|Things see fire too.}
I was. {~I bought bandages instead.|I forgot.} Say it. I forgot.
Double watch, then.
I missed twice today. Twice. I don't miss.
My arms weigh double. Yours?
Hunger. {~Two days of it.|We're eating tomorrow or we're not fighting.}
It's the food. Nothing else. We eat, we're fine.
Town. Or a goblin. I'll eat the goblin.
Ash in everything. My teeth, my boots, my {~soup|bow|sleep}.
The sky's been grey for a week. Is it the sky, or the Veil?
Both. {~That's the Ashen Wastes for you.|Breathe through cloth.}
It'll be worse in the breach. Enjoy the ash.
I miss rain. Never thought I'd say it.
There's no sky. I keep looking up and there's no sky.
Does anyone else hear it? Under the quiet.
The void has a sound. It's the sound of things being decided.
Don't listen to it. That's the whole trick.
I hear it. I'm choosing not to.
Sing something. Anything. Drown it.
Use a bandage, {answerer.name}. We have {party.bandages}.
Stop bleeding on the food. Bandage. Now.
Save them. {~Someone worse will need one.|Wounds heal.}
Fine. {~One.|Give it here.} Don't tell the cleric I complained.
I'll do it. Hold still.
New {weapon} on your chest. Fits?
That armour. Where'd you find it?
Off a {~dead thing|corpse|bandit}, like everything we own. {~It fits.|It'll fit once it's mine.}
Better than the {gear.replaced} by {gear.deltaAbs}. I feel taller.
Worse than the {gear.replaced}, truth be told. But look at it.
Looks heavy. Good. Stand in front.
This {weapon}. It has a name. Things with names are trouble.
I keep hearing the {weapon} hum at night. Is that normal?
Legendary work. Someone died for that to exist.
Trouble that kills faster. Keep it.
No. Nothing's normal. Sleep with it under you.
If it starts talking, wake me.
You pulled me back today, {answerer.name}. I felt it.
Thanks. For the thing. {~With the glowing.|Earlier.}
That's the job. Say it to the {$deity} if you must.
Stay in front of me and I'll keep doing it.
You're welcome. Now eat, or it was wasted.
I'd have caught you. Eventually.
{stats.kills} kills on the tally, {answerer.name}. Slow down.
The meter says {answerer.name} killed {stats.kills} things. I say the meter's a liar.
Numbers are honest. People aren't.
Somebody has to. {~They don't die on their own.|Easier than talking.}
I'll slow down when they do.
I softened half of them. Nobody counts softening.
{answerer.name}. Two fights. Zero kills. Explain.
Are you fighting or watching, {answerer.name}?
I keep you alive. Killing is your department.
I soften. You finish. That's a system.
Tomorrow. I'll get one tomorrow.
Softening. Right.
Level {memory.level}. I have a point to spend and no idea where.
Stronger today. The trainer would want {~gold|a speech|both}.
Buy the one that keeps you standing. Damage is vanity.
Anything that hits more things. That's the whole philosophy.
Spend it before a fight. Points don't help dead people.
I'd take the extra mana. But I'm biased.
We killed a {foe.sg} yesterday. Somebody say it out loud.
The {foe.sg}. Down. {~I still don't believe it.|Say something, one of you.}
It was always going to die. I just didn't say so before.
I can still smell it. {~That'll take a week.|Bath first, then pride.}
Next one's bigger. They're always bigger.
The road's open now. That's the real prize.
That shrine. Did anyone feel anything?
The water at the shrine. It was warm. Why was it warm?
Old gods don't ask why. Neither should you.
I felt a bruise go away. That's enough theology for me.
Something looked at us. Kindly, I think.
I took a coin from it. {~Don't.|It's a coin.}
{party.gold} gold between us. Who's buying the wagon?
We're rich, for a given value of rich.
Mine. Half of it. The good half.
Spend it before we lose it. Gold doesn't fight.
Rations. Then a mule. Then whatever's left is yours.
Buy the priest something. He looked hungry.
{party.gold} gold. That's a bad joke.
We can't afford the inn. Or the bridge. Or {~dignity|salt}.
Somebody sold the good sword. I'm not saying who.
We kill things for money. There's a lot of things. Do the sum.
There's a named bounty on the board. Names pay.
I still have my ring. {~It's not worth much.|Don't ask.}
Who's on first watch? {~Not me.|I did it last night.}
Watch order. Now. Before someone falls asleep mid-argument.
Me. I don't sleep much anyway.
{third.name} snores. {third.name} takes the first watch. Logic.
I'll take last watch. Dawn's the dangerous one.
I do not snore.
You were talking in your sleep, {answerer.name}.
Bad dreams again?
I don't dream. I plan. {~Loudly, apparently.}
Something was counting us. In the dream. {~It got to four and stopped.|It kept counting past four.}
Sleep closer to the fire.
Then we stay four. Simple.
You've been staring at the fire a lot, {answerer.name}.
Something on your mind?
Not the fire. {~Don't make it strange.|Forget I said that.}
The way you fought today. It was… {~fine. It was fine.|worth watching.}
Eat your food.
Then keep watching. I'll try to be worth it.
Tell the old one, {answerer.name}. The one about the first tear.
Give us a story. An old one.
When the Veil first tore, three practitioners stood on a stone older than stone and held the fire back for six hours. Two of them did not wake. That is why Clerics train to fight.
Before the Border Wars there was a king who asked the Veil a question. The answer was Emberglen. Nobody knows the question.
That's grim. {~Good.|Tell another.}
Bet you a ration I get more kills tomorrow than you, {answerer.name}.
Wager! Whoever hits the first goblin buys the drinks in town.
Done. Bring the ration.
I don't bet food. {~Bet gear.|Bet something you can lose.}
You're on. {~The loser carries the mule.|If we live.}
I'll hold the stakes. Trust me.
